verdict: CONFIRMED shared-mutable run cache race (SqlitePipelineStore._cache) between the scheduler execution thread and the stdio/host request thread calling GetTaskProjection(fresh=True) -> store.refresh()

root_cause.one_line: SqlitePipelineStore caches PipelineRun objects in a plain shared dict (_cache) while sqlite connections are thread-routed; GetTaskProjection calls pipeline.get_task_projection(fresh=True) -> store.refresh(), which replaces the cache entry with a newly loaded clone. The scheduler thread's execute_run keeps executing its own (now-stale) object, while commit_step_result/_find_step read the clone. Result: commit+backfill land on the clone, the stale object keeps the old regionless unit list -> downstream ocr INVALID_INPUT; the stale object's later _persist writes the pre-commit state back over pipeline_runs.run_json -> StepRun stuck at running.

code_points.detail: reads DB then self._cache[run_id] = run (replaces the object the executor thread is using)
commit_step_result resolves run via store.get() -> cache -> clone
whole-run JSON write; stale local run overwrites newer committed state
connections ARE thread-routed correctly; the leak is the un-shared cache, not the sqlite connection

root_cause.trigger: any client calling GetTaskProjection while a Run is being executed (projection face is designed for UI polling)

thread_and_connection_routing.note: facade identity is shared (same ThreadRoutedConnection object); the per-thread sqlite3.Connection differs as designed; _cache is a plain dict shared by both threads.

fix_recommendation.minimal: Stop view reads from mutating the execution cache: make get_run_snapshot(fresh=True)/refresh() return a detached read without replacing _cache[run_id] (or add a separate read-only path used by GetTaskProjection). Add a regression test: execute_run on one thread while another thread polls get_task_projection(fresh=True) -> run must complete with zero stuck StepRuns and no regionless-unit INVALID_INPUT.
fix_recommendation.hardening: Also guard the whole-run write: pipeline_runs.run_json is last-writer-wins across threads. Either keep execution writes on the owner thread only (reject writes from non-owner runs) or add an updated_at/revision CAS check so a stale snapshot cannot overwrite a newer one.
fix_recommendation.suggested_next_task: RUN-STORE-CACHE-RACE-FIX-1 (implementation; small, Core-only, with concurrency regression test).

product_impact.frozen_repro: packaged core_service.exe (sha256 2b36bfeb…4ec519b) with projection polling: 3 detect steps stuck running + regionless ocr INVALID_INPUT on 3 pages; with snapshot-only polling: 0 stuck (clean).
product_impact.current_gui_polling: Avalonia Host wires library_get_task_projection (apps/desktop-avalonia/src/NewManga.App/Shell/ReaderWorkbenchSupport.cs:195, CoreClient/Commands/HostCommandRegistry.cs:102/147) but no viewmodel invokes it on a timer yet -> the shipped GUI does not trigger it today; any workbench projection polling (next S4 UI batch), Host integration test or diagnostic tool that polls the face does.
product_impact.verdict: latent production defect in shipped binary; must be fixed before the workbench projection polling lands (or any tool that polls GetTaskProjection during a run).
